title: ST-depression–angina interaction does not establish incremental coronary-disease prediction across Cleveland and Hungarian referral cohorts
abstract: In 303 Cleveland training and 293 Hungarian confirmation patients, adding ST-depression × exercise-angina to a fixed flexible additive logistic model changed external log loss from 0.441976 to 0.444697. Baseline-minus-augmented loss was -0.002721 (paired bootstrap95%CI [-0.010914, 0.005374]); incremental benefit was not established.
